result:
**Round 38 result: PASS.** All six acceptance checks (R38-1 to R38-6) passed, and I checked the real app myself (`realVerified=true`). I found one low-severity test gap and no bugs in A's code. The report is in `c-round-38.md` and `c-round-38.json`, with evidence in `c-round-38/`.

**What the real app shows (old `ea4a1cb` build vs new build, keyboard only, under xvfb):**
- **Done while busy (K1):** in the new build, focus stays on the `Applying...` button and it is marked unavailable and busy. Pressing Enter and Space again starts no extra schema read: both builds show the same two reads of the new folder, one from the folder load and one from Done. In the old build, focus drops to `<body>`.
- **Save Tags (K2):** in the new build, focus stays on the button while saving and after the save. A second Enter during the write and one more after it write nothing, so there is exactly one write. In the old build, focus drops to `<body>`. Both ffprobe and music-metadata read `a.wav` back as `ICAT=R38Focus`, and every other file is unchanged.
- **Clean Save Tags with Tab (K3):** in the new build, Tab reaches Save Tags (marked unavailable), and Enter writes nothing. In the old build, Tab skips the button.
- **Batch save (K4):** focus is kept and there is one batch write. Both readers show `ICAT=R38Batch` in both files.
- **Arrow opacity while Applying:** new build: middle arrow 0.6, edge arrow 0.18, Done 0.5. Old build: middle arrow 0.18. Busy and clean buttons match the old disabled look (opacity 0.5, not-allowed cursor).
- No page errors or console errors in any of the 8 runs.

**Gates and tests:**
- **Gate:** the full verify command from a clean state exits 0. Renderer tests pass 304/304, main 93/93, E2E 7/7, and E2E with no retries 7/7. Biome reports 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as before.
- **Red then green:** A's tests against the old source give 30 failed / 274 passed, as B predicted. On A's tree they pass 304/304 twice, and each changed test file passes on its own.
- **Ownership:** only the 8 allowed files changed, and the code and test changes match B's prototype exactly. Source was unchanged from the start to the end of my check.
- **Mutation tests:** all 11 of B's code changes (mutants) are caught by the tests. Of my 7 extra ones, two survive without a finding:
  - removing the new `aria-disabled` class from the shared Button: the real-app opacity and cursor checks cover it;
  - writing the edge arrow class as `disabled:opacity-30`: it behaves the same, because edge arrows are always natively disabled.
- **Docs:** line references, counts (21 entries / 12 fixed / 5 open questions for Saba), unchanged entries and both reference URLs all check out.

**Finding C-R38-01 (low, test gap):** no test covers an empty field list showing Done as unavailable. Removing `fields.length === 0` from Done's `aria-disabled` still passes all tests. The click guard still blocks the action, so users see no difference. It fits next round's TM-B41, which only adds tests.

**For B to look at:** after a batch save, the form shows "Multiple values" in every field even though both files now have the same Category. The old build does exactly the same, so this round didn't cause it, but it may be an existing bug.

I couldn't apply two clarifications to `c-round-38.md` after writing it: the edits were refused for lack of permission. They are:
- the K2 check compares every field, not only Category, because the files contain only `ICAT` and an empty `IKEY`;
- in K1, two reads in the old build and two in the new build show that the extra Enter/Space added none.

Windows packaging is BLOCKED (not available in the cloud) and isn't part of this round.
